blocks.text: Before integrating Zscaler Deception with a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution, a Service Connector must be configured. A Service Connector is an application that communicates with the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal and sends events and audit logs to the SIEM solution. You can integrate a Service Connector with one or multiple SIEM solutions.
Service Connectors provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Forward the events recorded by Zscaler Deception to one or more SIEM solutions for real-time analysis of the log data in a centralized view.
Leverage built-in Service Connectors or configure your own Service Connectors by using the executables provided in the Deception Admin Portal.

blocks.text: By default, Service Connectors are automatically configured in the Deception Admin Portal and each Decoy Connector. These Service Connectors are always running and cannot be deleted.
You can configure a Service Connector externally within your organization by downloading the executables (Windows or Linux) from the Deception Admin Portal.
On the Service Connectors page (Orchestrate > Service Connectors), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of all configured Service Connectors. For each Service Connector, you can see:
Name: The name of the Service Connector.
Version: The current version of the Service Connector.
Syslog Receiver Source: The name of the syslog receiver type that is configured.
Syslog Receiver Allowed IPs: The IP addresses to allow inbound connections from a configured syslog receiver.
Edit or delete a Service Connector.
